author: Pryr
body:
Hi mods,
Pls can I get unbanned. I got banned on September 20 2015 by Pelpelajax for ban evasion. However, it wasn't me playing on the account when I was banned. It was actually my brother called BucketsOfSweat who got banned for aimbot a while ago and he wanted to play on my account and he mentioned his real account so he got me banned. So unban me pls. Thx
-Sonic_Soundz
